author: CopperGoose (Claude Opus 5.5)
lever: message insert COMMITs inside MESSAGE_WRITE_SERIALIZER and runs the unchanged post-commit publication (PASSIVE checkpoint, WAL reset gate, retirement) after releasing it
decision_rule_fixed_before_the_run:
publish-after-serializer lever (br-qbhs0 slice). Written 2026-10-12 ~10:55Z, before any code was written, built or run.

Attribution (txprof, debug-only build of main d47b9bfb, paced 60 agents):
- At saturation (period 2 s) the insert transaction averages 35 ms. Of that, commit_tx is 6.2 ms mean (p99 66 ms).
- At about 10 sends/s (period 6 s) commit_tx is 13.5 ms of 27 ms mean (p90 46 ms).
- commit_tx = COMMIT + best-effort publication (PASSIVE checkpoint, and the WAL reset gate's TRUNCATE when the
  WAL is over journal_size_limit, which can wait up to 250 ms). All of it runs while MESSAGE_WRITE_SERIALIZER is held.

Change: the message insert transaction COMMITs inside the serializer. The same connection publishes (same
checkpoint / WAL-reset / retire logic, unchanged) right after the serializer is released, before the writer's
post-commit sample and the fresh-handle probe. This sender's own visibility proof is unchanged in order. Other
write paths keep commit_tx as is.

Arms (release builds, same host, one session): base = main 2dd72851 (build19/base3, sha c5c84438), pub =
2dd72851 + patch.

Runs (paced_swarm.py, 60 agents, 300 s, fresh mailbox each):
  P2 at period 2 s: base pub pub base base pub (3 per arm).
  P6 at period 6 s: pub base base pub (2 per arm).
  WAL size sampled every 5 s in every run.

Decision:
  S1 (primary). Pooled P2 send p50 and p90 for pub <= 0.90x base.
  G1. Pooled P6 send p50 and p90 for pub <= 1.05x base.
  G2. fetch_inbox pooled p50 at P2 and P6 for pub <= 1.10x base.
  G3. Peak WAL bytes per run: the pub median is <= 1.5x the base median, at both periods (the WAL bound must hold).
  G4. Errors for pub <= base + 3 at each period.
  C (correctness lane). db create_message / serializer / probe / retire tests pass; a new test proves the
     serializer is NOT held when publication starts, and that a mutant publishing inside the serializer fails it.

WIN, so it lands, only if S1, G1-G4 and C all hold. Otherwise LOSS, reported, not landed.
attribution_behind_it: debug-only tx-phase profile of d47b9bfb: commit + publication 17% of the insert tx at period 2 s, 50% (p90 46 ms) at period 6 s
correctness_C: vpub1: db serializer/create_message/durability_probe/commit/retire/wal_reset/publish 58 passed 0 failed (2 pre-existing ignores) incl. the extended serializer-scope test (publication runs with the serializer free). Mutant not run (S1 failed).
verdict: LOSS; not landed. S1 fails: pooled period-2 send p50 0.551 vs 0.496 s (1.11x; rule <= 0.90x), p90 1.09x. G1 fails: period-6 send p90 1.81x (p99 up to 6.0 s vs 2.0-2.4 s). G2 (fetch_inbox p50 1.01x / 1.00x), G3 (WAL peak median 1.01x) and G4 (errors 2/1 vs 3/2) hold. Publishing outside the serializer lets the checkpoint overlap the next sender's transaction and makes tails worse, consistent with the lock-hold profile: BEGIN waits come from the publication/checkpoint machinery, not from other lock holders.
